hotspots.title: Arson attack on Italian journalist sparks outrage
hotspots.blurb: A series of articles detail an arson attack on journalist Adriano Cappellari in Vicenza, Italy, with threats also directed at Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni and anti-crime priest Don Maurizio Patriciello. The attack is linked to Cappellari's reporting on organized crime in Caivano.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the violent targeting of a journalist, which strikes at the heart of press freedom and public safety concerns.

hotspots.title: Poland-Ukraine tensions over historical honors
hotspots.blurb: Poland's President Karol Nawrocki has threatened to revoke Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky's Order of the White Eagle after Ukraine named a military unit after the Ukrainian Insurgent Army (UPA), which is linked to massacres of Poles during World War II. This has sparked a diplomatic row and internal political debates in Poland.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the moral and historical weight of the issue, which touches on national identity, historical grievances, and diplomatic relations.
